resume: Derived from X0X, a stereo groovebox with a 909, an 808, two 303s, a breakbeat player, a song mode and an Orb-style remix: independent bank and pattern for each part. It adds Grids rhythm generation, the extended TB-3PO and the Morph waveform for the 303s.

commandes.role: Steps by sixteen; on HOME and SONG, patterns 1 to 16 or 17 to 32; on the 303 keyboard, the octave; in a generator, mutes or writes a new pattern.

Reverb and delay.
The whole screen as a list, including settings without a page; in a question, yes.
Held while pressing a key: an accent; held while turning KNOB 1 to 4: resets the parameter to its default value.
The mixer and the master; held while pressing a key: a glissando.
The sound of the chosen part; the keys always write its steps.
The settings; pressing again closes.
The pattern and its five parts, mutes; pressing again opens the song. Held: + REC undoes, + PLAY redoes, + SELECT sets the tempo, + white key picks a pattern.
Saves everything (during playback, when stopped); held, copies the pattern, then a white key pastes it.
GRIDS on 909 and 808, TB-3PO on 303A and 303B; pressing again moves to the next page.
The steps of the chosen part, with LENGTH and RATE.
Starts and stops.
Records notes, hits, knob movements and, on SONG, the song; on a 303, the keys become a keyboard.
Volume.
Previous or next page; in a list, moves up and down.
Next pattern: for the part alone on its screen, for all five on HOME.
Picks the part: 909, 808, 303A, 303B or BREAK; in a list, changes the value.
The steps; on HOME, the patterns.
The drum tracks or the break slices; on HOME, mute the parts.

gestes: HOME held + REC: undo; + PLAY: redo (up to 32 changes).
A button held for one second: a card says what it does.
a_savoir: Only one of the two 303s can use the Morph waveform at a time, and it remains experimental.
BREAK has no recorded break: two loops produced by the engines, 909 GR and 808 GR.
